tools.name: check_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a person or entity against global sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, UK OFSI, EU Consolidated, UN Consolidated). Returns matches with confidence scores.

tools.name: check_pep
tools.description: Check if a person is a Politically Exposed Person (PEP). 11.7K+ PEP records from Wikidata.

tools.name: check_entity
tools.description: Search legal entities by name in GLEIF database (20K+ records). Returns LEI, legal name, jurisdiction.
